evidence: PATHS: instruction.md:11 names /instructions/hireops_rules.md and /instructions/integration.md; instruction.md:13 names /assets/seed_data.json. All three exist under environment/ (environment/instructions/{hireops_rules.md,integration.md}, environment/assets/seed_data.json, the only asset). environment/Dockerfile:14-16 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/', 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; Dockerfile byte-identical to frozen template. task.toml:2 artifacts=["/app","/assets"]. SOLUTION COPY: environment/assets/seed_data.json and solution/app/src/seed_data.json are byte-identical (sha256 a1c65c80...3740, 28549 bytes; also equals live projects/ copy and the raw-evidence-index matching_source_files entry). db.js:10 reads it via path.join(__dirname,'seed_data.json'), consistent with instruction.md:15 (copy into /app; /assets unavailable at runtime) and rules section 8. CONTENT vs PROMPT/RULES: 10 users with emails/roles exactly matching instruction.md:17 and app_context.md:10-19 (3 recruiter, 3 hiring_manager, 1 observer, 3 candidate); no password in seed, password supplied by brief (db.js:63). stages and candidate_status_labels match rules section 7 table exactly; thread_page_size=30 matches rules section 6/9; 3 jobs (rules section 9, app_context.md:29); interview_limit 3/2/3 all within 1..50 and no job over capacity (PLAT 2 in Interview). One long conversation: APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context.md:30 '120 messages'), exact 4 pages of 30; per-conversation timestamps sorted and unique so array order and time order agree. reads use read_count semantics defined in rules section 9 ('how many messages ... counted from its first'); db.js:82-83 maps read_count-1 to message id consistently. Candidate ownership by email: Noor->APP-101,APP-302; Tomas->APP-201; Lena->APP-301 (rejected from SCREEN with reason, exercising candidate redaction). All message senders are permitted participants (no candidate in another's thread, managers only on own job, no observer sends). Notes: APP-101 by its job manager Ingrid. CONTENT vs JUDGES: functional prompt.md:25 / judge.toml:344 'Lena ... starts with 1 unread' -> computed: APP-301 3 msgs, Lena read_count 2, message 3 from USR-REC3 => 1 unread. prompt.md:25 / judge.toml:416 seeded Platform Engineer order Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi; Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz -> seed positions 1,2,3 / 1,2 exactly; 'Noor Haddad's seeded internal note' -> note on APP-101 exists. judge.toml:326/335 most recent 30 and 30-at-a-time with remaining count -> 120 messages supports 3 earlier pages. Fallback in protocol T uses Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation whose manager is Bill (JOB-DATA manager_id USR-MGR2), consistent with judge.toml:362 'the job's hiring manager (Bill)'. polish judge.toml:32/41 and visual prompt.md:14 use Noor's Platform Engineer long conversation and Noor's candidate view; both exist. Scripted golden evidence (raw-evidence-index; workspace.cjs 805eb274... and results/workspace.json 47c2e8ef... re-hashed and match) records 'seeded card order and internal notes are loaded' passed - scripted, not a judge run. ADVERSARIAL: broken app that ignores the asset and fabricates data fails Z's seeded-order and Lena-unread readings and the 120-message paging rows; a conforming alternative reading read_count as 0-based index would be wrong only against an explicit public definition (rules section 9), so no hidden requirement; stage keys are uppercase codes in seed but the display mapping is explicit in rules sections 3/7. No mismatch found. Not done by me: Docker image build (mechanical half owned by check-assets-referenced.py/check-fixtures.py, reviewed by the deterministic reviewer); COPY lines are plain and template-identical.
